I told Pree in our direct message that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is **21 October**. She set it on 14 October, and our direct messages show no change since then.

The private note I saved in gbrain didn't come back when I looked it up: the lookup returned nothing for her. I got the answer by reading her own messages to me instead. That means the private note may not work for future reminders, and the direct message thread is the reliable record for now.
